## Checkbox.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `checked` :: Whether the box is checked. Two-way bindable.
- `indeterminate` :: Shows the mixed state: a dash instead of a check. Cleared by the next user toggle. Two-way bindable.
- `label` :: The visible label, drawn beside the box.
- `description` :: Secondary text under the label, in a quieter ink.
- `size` :: The box and text scale.
- `textSize` :: The text scale, independent of the box. Follows `size` when omitted.
- `invalid` :: Marks the box as failing validation: a danger border and `aria-invalid`.
- `name` :: The field name submitted with a form.
- `value` :: The value submitted with a form when checked.
- `onCheckedChange` :: Called after the user toggles the box, with the new checked state.
- `children` :: Rich label content, used in place of `label`.
- `disabled` :: Blocks pointer and keyboard input, and dims the label.
- `childTextSize` :: The scale of the description under the label. @default 'text-sm'
- `childTextColor` :: The ink of the description under the label. @default 'text-secondary'
- `gap` :: The space between the box and the label. @default 'gap-sm'
